description: Add SASL (RFC 4422) as the auth negotiation framework for federation handshakes. Instead of hardwiring auth mechanisms per transport, the federation handshake does TLS connect → SASL mechanism negotiation → auth → JMAP. Each auth mechanism (TOFU, ACME, DANE, self-signed, PKIX, DID) becomes a SASL mechanism plugin rather than a separate code path. Key mechanisms: EXTERNAL (transport-layer auth, what Tailscale does now), SCRAM-SHA-256 (mutual auth with shared secret), OAUTHBEARER (OIDC providers). The rsasl crate provides the framework. Sits inside FederationTransport::identify_caller — the trait surface doesn't change.
title: Auth framework: SASL negotiation layer
